value: Financial & Business Systems | Accounting, Payments, Data & Platforms

Software engineer and technical leader with experience across ERP, data platforms, lending, banking and payments. I combine hands-on development, domain modeling, architecture and engineering management to connect business rules with reliable, testable systems designed to evolve. My current work includes financial-platform development and engineering workflows for collaboration between people and AI-assisted tools.

I am a hands-on software engineer and technical leader with experience in ERP, data, lending, banking and payment-related systems. I connect accounting and financial domain knowledge with architecture, implementation, product decisions and operations.

My approach is that of a systems generalist: understand how a problem works, connect the relevant perspectives and develop deeper expertise where the work requires it. Finance is a strong foundation of my experience, not a restriction to one industry.

I document an initial model, build to discover what is missing, and use representative and adverse cases to revise both the software and the specification. I design for reliability and expected change rather than treating the first delivery as the only measure of success.

I remain involved in code while working with engineers, product and operations. My current work also includes specifications, review, testing and reproducible development workflows for human and AI-assisted contributions.
Worked on Money-In experiences and transfer-visibility tools for Brazil, Mexico and Colombia, using Clojure, Datomic, GraphQL and microservice integrations.
Developed customer-facing Money-In features in a full-stack environment using Clojure and Nubank's internal application framework.
Applied knowledge of payment systems in Brazil, Colombia and Mexico to investigate and implement transfer-related behavior.
Delivered transfer-visibility tools for customer support in Colombia and Mexico, integrating React and Clojure with GraphQL and internal microservices.
Used Grafana and other internal tools for service observability and debugging; created documentation to understand platform behavior.
Collaborated with distributed teams in English, Spanish and Portuguese, using AI-assisted coding tools alongside implementation and review.

value.summary: Design and development of financial systems, combining payment and accounting-domain modeling, software architecture, hands-on implementation and engineering-team development.
highlights: Model payment, pricing, FX, accounting and reconciliation workflows in collaboration with product, engineering and operations.
Design boundaries between economic records and external payment execution, with explicit responsibilities and traceable operations.
Develop specifications, contract and end-to-end tests, provider simulations and reproducible development environments to verify complete business flows.
Coordinate engineering and AI-assisted contributions through documentation, review and integration, while remaining involved in implementation and engineer development.
